name: Tiledesk
description: Open source live chat and chatbot platform for customer support and lead engagement.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      MONGODB_URI: "mongodb://{{serviceName}}-mongo:27017/tiledesk"
      JWT_SECRET: {{env.JWT_SECRET}}
  {{serviceName}}-mongo:
    image: mongo:6
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-dashboard:
    image: tiledesk/tiledesk-dashboard:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-dashboard
    restart: unless-stopped
